snip.t: Any dry cough?” — Interstitial lung disease (ILD) and pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) are leading causes of mortality.

Cor pulmonale (in chronic bronchitis): Chronic hypoxic vasoconstriction → pulmonary arterial hypertension → right‑ventricular overload — Peripheral oedema, raised JVP, hepatomegaly; predicts higher mortality — Develops over years of untreated disease
Group 1: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) — Idiopathic, HIV, portal hypertension, schistosomiasis, congenital heart disease (e.g., VSD, PDA, ASD with Eisenmenger's)
HIV/AIDS: Increases vulnerability to opportunistic polymicrobial sepsis, tuberculous pericarditis, pulmonary arterial hypertension, and dilated cardiomyopathy.
Lung interstitium & pulmonary vasculature: Fibrosis → interstitial lung disease (ILD); vasculopathy → pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
